array_archive.scope: Saved source matrices and synthetic/frozen occupation witnesses only; no F or energy evaluated for witness D

limitations: Frozen F/S occupation witnesses are not new self-consistent states, executable seeds or energies.
Every witness has its own density identity; no old F(D) or energy is relabelled as belonging to a new D.
Exact inertia and the strict gap bound concern represented binary64 lower-triangle matrices.
The Weyl necessary-change bound assumes exactly the same fixed positive definite S; it is not sufficient to ensure an accepted root.
Approximate NumPy whitening/eigenvectors have no exact numerical error certificate and never replace saved SciPy gate values.
Saved symmetry residuals do not prove exact physical symmetry, symmetry of all roots or arbitrary-D sigma/pi decoupling.
Passing pure-array trace/idempotency/reconstruction checks does not execute either solver admission contract.
No method approval, numerical endpoint qualification, stability, research result or Compute activation is granted.
